description: Header file defining ViewModel classes for graphing calculator equations, including EquationViewModel, GridDisplayItems, and KeyGraphFeaturesItem, with properties and methods for data binding and feature analysis.

classes.name: GridDisplayItems
classes.description: Data class for displaying grid items with expression and direction properties.

classes.name: KeyGraphFeaturesItem
classes.description: Data class representing key features of graph items, including title, display items, grid items, and text flag.

classes.name: EquationViewModel
classes.description: ViewModel class for representing and managing a graph equation, including properties for expression, color, line enablement, and key graph features.

methods.name: EquationViewModel
methods.description: Constructor initializing the equation view model with equation data, label index, color, and color index.

methods.name: PopulateKeyGraphFeatures
methods.description: Populates key graph features based on provided info.

methods.name: EquationErrorText
methods.description: Returns error text for a given error type and code.

methods.name: AddKeyGraphFeature
methods.description: Adds a key graph feature with title, expression, and error string.

methods.name: AddKeyGraphFeature
methods.description: Adds a key graph feature with title, expression vector, and error string.
